title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
description: Gaeng keow wan gai. The trick is cracking the coconut cream with the paste before anything else joins — that split, oily stage is where the flavour comes from.

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.note: full fat; do not shake the tin

steps.text: Spoon the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk tin into a hot pan and fry the green curry paste in it until the fat splits out and the mixture darkens.
steps.tip: You are looking for visible oil pooling at the edges. Rushing this leaves the curry tasting raw.

steps.text: Add the chicken and turn it through the paste until it is coated and sealed.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk with the kaffir lime leaves and bring to a bare simmer.
Add the Thai eggplant and simmer until tender but not collapsing.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar, tasting as you go — it should land salty, sweet, and hot in that order.
Take off the heat and stir through the Thai basil and sliced red chilli.
